title: 几款公路自行车平价轮胎使用感受
notes: Owner post (2025-05-16): an uncontrolled comparison of four 28C clinchers (Chaoyang Cobra Pro 496, IRC Jetty Plus, CST C3045, Kenda K925) at 85/90 psi. Rolling and grip were ridden; puncture and wear rankings were inferred from materials because no puncture occurred. The same owner posted a second comparison on 2025-05-30.
